learning_outcomes.text: Acquire skills on the fundamental aspects of the connection between Engineering and Sustainability and respective challenges.
Address fundamental concepts about sustainability in its environmental, economic, and social aspects.
Promote the learning of a set of knowledge in the area of sustainable development, namely, obtaining an overview of: The fundamentals of Sustainable Development.

Obtain an overview of: The regulatory and strategic framework for Sustainable Development, namely the United Nations 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, the Paris Agreement on Climate Change, and the Action Plan for Financing Development.
Obtain an overview of: The business approach to sustainable development and environmental, social, and corporate governance standards.

Obtain an overview of: The challenges of climate and energy transition: scenarios and impacts; regulatory framework; carbon neutrality trajectories and cost-benefit evaluation of decarbonisation; strategies to promote renewable energies, energy efficiency, and sustainable mobility.
Obtain an overview of: Challenges, strategies, regulation, technologies, and economic assessment in the management of water resources, protection of biodiversity, and enhancement of natural capital.
Obtain an overview of: Sustainable development financing mechanisms, the relevance of development cooperation, and innovative sustainable financing instruments.

syllabus_topics: The strategic framework of Sustainable Development
The challenges of the climate and energy transition
The challenges of protecting and enhancing natural capital
teaching_methods: Theoretical-practical classes of exposition and discussion of different themes
assessment_rules: The evaluation will be distributed with a final exam. The final classification is calculated as 20% for participation in classes (PA) + 80% for the exam (E). Frequency of classes is mandatory according to FEUP rules. Classification improvement is possible through the preparation of an assigned work on the topic.
